## 天赋与构筑

On this page, you will find out the best talents for your Arms Warrior in World of Warcraft Patch
  12.1.5. We also have default talent builds for various types of content, such as raiding or Mythic+.
  If you play with Warmode on, we have your PvP talents covered as well.

1.

### Best Midnight Talents for Arms Warrior

Arms is enjoying one of its most powerful seasons in Mythic+ in Season 2, being 
one of the stronger damage dealers outside of specific meta comps. Arms unfortunately
only excels in a couple of raid encounters, but still remains above average 
overall.

- **Single Target -** ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/slayer.webp>) Slayer continues to be significantly 
    ahead in single-target and most raid encounters.
- **AoE -** ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/slayer.webp>) Slayer has risen to be the main multi-target 
    damage dealing hero tree choice. ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/colossus.webp>) Colossus can still offer higher 
    multi-target burst, but it loses much more single-target value in the

which increases the value of Slam and buffs other rotational abilities. While 
it largely takes the place of regular casts of Slam, it will also be 
periodically weaved into the single target Execute phase. In multi-target,

Since Battle for Azeroth, players have the option to go into "War Mode,"
allowing them to participate in PvP combat with other players. Enabling War
Mode provides the following benefits:

- PvP talents enabled in the outdoor world
- 10% increase in World Quest rewards at maximum level
- 10% more experience gained while leveling
- Earn Conquest Points, which can reward gear every week

With the benefits of enabling War Mode for leveling and PvE content, it is
recommended to enable the feature to maximize your leveling and rewards at
maximum level. However, you will make yourself available for open-world PvP,
and the possibility of being "ganked" while leveling or doing World Quests
exists.

### 巅峰天赋： ![Master of Warfare Icon](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/large_icons/misc_legionfall_warrior.jpg>) 战争大师

武器 战士的终极天赋[[spell:1269314]]是一个主动触发技能，它能提高猛击的价值并增强其他循环技能。虽然它在很大程度上取代了猛击的常规施放，但也会定期穿插在单体斩杀阶段中使用。然而在多目标环境中，该技能始终会通过[[spell:202316]]被动使用。

- 第一点是一个触发效果，使[[spell:1269383]]替换猛击，赋予其更高的优先级，并触发一个小的护甲穿透增益效果。虽然这个增益效果可以叠加，但每层都有各自的持续时间，导致增益效果不断叠加和衰减，使其很容易被动处理并忽略。
- 第二点和第三点进一步增强战争大师增益效果，但对循环没有影响，因为所有这些技能继续以相同的方式使用。
- 最后一点使英勇打击施加一个单独的增益效果，提高巨神兵 猛击的强度，考虑到该技能如此高的覆盖率，这可能相当强大。

### PvP天赋（战争模式）

自《争霸艾泽拉斯》以来，玩家可以选择进入“战争模式”，使他们能够与其他玩家进行PvP战斗。启用战争模式可获得以下好处：

- 在户外世界启用PvP天赋
- 在最高等级时，世界任务奖励提高10%
- 升级时获得的经验值提高10%
- 赚取征服点数，每周可兑换装备奖励

鉴于启用战争模式对升级和PvE内容的好处，建议启用该功能以最大化你的升级效率和满级后的奖励。然而，你将使自己成为开放世界PvP的目标，并且在升级或进行世界任务时存在被“偷袭”的可能性。

1. [[spell:198817]]增加一个独立的非公共冷却增益，提升[[spell:12294]]的整体伤害。
2. [[spell:213915]]提升了[[spell:23920]]的价值，在冷却时间略微延长的同时提供更多的进攻和防御价值。

some minor performance-enhancing customization options after a multi-week quest series.

### Apex Talent: ![Rampaging Berserker Icon](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/large_icons/inv_12_nonmasculinecharacter_orc.jpg>) Rampaging Berserker

The Fury Warrior apex talent, [[spell:1269308]], is very 
straightforward, passively increasing the value of Recklessness and Rampage in 
three parts.

- The first point triggers the [[spell:106951]] buff every time Rampage is 
  cast, passively increasing strength. While this buff stacks, each has its own 
  duration, resulting in the buff constantly stacking and decaying, making it 
  easy to treat passively and ignore.
- The second and third points passively increase the damage of Rampage and 
  reduce its Rage cost during Recklessness. This allows the powerful attack to 
  be used much more frequently and stack the Berserk buff much higher during the 
  cooldown window.
- The fourth point increases the duration of Recklessness and grants three 
  stacks of Berserk whenever the cooldown is used, further enhancing its damage 
  potential.

4.

### Hero Talents

Fury Warriors have a choice between ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/slayer.webp>) Slayer and ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/mountain-thane.webp>) Mountain Thane, each with their 
own strengths, focus, and minor gameplay differences.

4.1.

#### ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/slayer.webp>) Slayer

![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/slayer.webp>) Slayer is focused on Execute and Bladestorm, with the main 
gameplay difference being increased [[spell:280721]] procs. It tends to be 
the better choice for raid encounters, due to its high priority damage and 
easy cleave, though is currently enjoying renewed interest in Mythic+ as well.

4.2.

#### ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/mountain-thane.webp>) Mountain Thane

![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/mountain-thane.webp>) Mountain Thane uses [[spell:6343]] instead of [[spell:1680]], with a 
strong emphasis on [[spell:23881]] to trigger enhanced [[spell:435607]]s. Due to its 
innate multi-target, it tends to be used more frequently in Mythic+ 
instead of raid encounters.

5.

### PvP Talents (War Mode)

Since Battle for Azeroth, players have the option to go into "War Mode,"
allowing them to participate in PvP combat with other players. Enabling War
Mode provides the following benefits:

- PvP talents enabled in the outdoor world
- 10% increase in World Quest rewards at maximum level
- 10% more experience gained while leveling
- Earn Conquest Points, which can reward gear every week

With the benefits of enabling War Mode for leveling and PvE content, it is
recommended to enable the feature to maximize your leveling and rewards at
maximum level. However, you will make yourself available for open-world PvP,
and the possibility of being "ganked" while leveling or doing World Quests
exists.

1. [[spell:206572]] grants extra mobility, which is always useful while 
   leveling.
2. [[spell:213915]] boosts the value of [[spell:23920]], providing
   both more offensive and defensive value in exchange for a slightly longer
   cooldown.
3. [[spell:411764]] is rather a niche but provides a small bonus
   whenever crowd-controlled.

[[spell:199261]] is also a powerful offensive option, although maintaining
it is cumbersome in open-world content due to the necessity of refreshing
the buff every 15 seconds, and the ability cannot be cast while mounted,
flying, or otherwise not in control of your character.

- 第四点延长了 鲁莽 的持续时间，并在使用冷却技能时提供三层狂暴，进一步增强其伤害潜力。

#### ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/slayer.webp>) 斩杀者

![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/slayer.webp>) 屠戮者 侧重于 斩杀 和剑刃风暴，主要的游戏差异在于 [[spell:280721]] 触发更频繁。由于其高优先级伤害和轻松的顺劈，它通常是团队副本战斗的更好选择，尽管目前在大秘境中也重新受到关注。

4.2.

#### ![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/mountain-thane.webp>) 山丘领主

![](<https://static.icy-veins.com/images/wow/tools/hero-talents/mountain-thane.webp>) 山丘领主 使用 [[spell:6343]] 而非 [[spell:1680]]，并高度强调 [[spell:23881]] 以触发强化的 [[spell:435607]]。由于其固有的多目标能力，它在大秘境中比团队副本中使用得更频繁。

1.

### PvP天赋（战争模式）

自《争霸艾泽拉斯》以来，玩家可以选择进入“战争模式”，使他们能够与其他玩家进行PvP战斗。启用战争模式可获得以下好处：

- 在户外世界启用PvP天赋
- 在最高等级时，世界任务奖励提高10%
- 升级时获得的经验值提高10%
- 赚取征服点数，每周可兑换装备奖励

鉴于启用战争模式对升级和PvE内容的好处，建议启用该功能以最大化你的升级效率和满级后的奖励。然而，你将使自己成为开放世界PvP的目标，并且在升级或进行世界任务时存在被“偷袭”的可能性。

1. [[spell:206572]]提供额外的机动性，这在练级时总是有用的。
2. [[spell:213915]]提升了[[spell:23920]]的价值，在冷却时间略微延长的同时提供更多的进攻和防御价值。
3. [[spell:411764]] 属于小众选择，但在被控制时会提供一个小的加成。

[[spell:199261]] 同样是一个强大的进攻选择，不过在开放世界内容中维持它很麻烦，因为每15秒就需要刷新一次增益，而且在骑乘、飞行或以其他方式无法控制角色时无法施放该技能。

One of the most noticeable effects is how strongly they incentivize investing in talents that enhance [[spell:341491]]. Due to this synergy we are strongly encouraged to build around maximizing our [[spell:341491]] generation and damage, which in turn encourages us to take more talents that support this playstyle. With the full power of all Apex talents you are also introduced to the new gameplay loop with encouraging Idol spawns to proc more [[spell:341491]]. This is where you get to pick between ![]() Archon or ![]() Voidweaver. 4.1. #### ![]() Archon ![]() Archon Shadow Priest gameplay revolves around using [[spell:120644]] to empower your [[spell:228260]] and to cast extremely powerful [[spell:391399]] spells. Utility wise ![]() Archon gives you [[spell:453726]] for 5% more stamina. This only applies to yourself as the Priest. For Mythic+ ![]() Archon also brings important utility for your group in the form of [[spell:453918]] for an extra stop. 4.2. #### ![]() Voidweaver ![]() Voidweaver Shadow Priests get access to [[spell:263165]] to create a heavy hitting [[spell:447444]] that pulses AoE damage to enemies in its radius. This then gives you access to an upgraded [[spell:8092]] in the form of [[spell:450405]] while the Rift is active. Voidweaver gets even better during raid encounters where you can take advantage of [[spell:451840]]. Utility of ![]() Voidweaver is much better compared to ![]() Archon for Raiding as it not only has great self-defensive options with [[spell:451311]] or [[spell:451569]] but also grants cast while moving to [[spell:263165]] with [[spell:451018]]. 5. ### Shadow Priest Choice Talent Nodes This section is intended to give more context on the various choice nodes we have in the Shadow Priest spec tree and when each choice might make sense. :::details ![]() Click for Additional Talent Information 5.1. #### Invoked Nightmare vs Misery This is one of the most impactful and playstyle defining choice nodes in the Shadow Priest tree.[[spell:1279350]] and [[spell:238558]] fundamentally change how damage is ramped and applied, making this decision highly dependent on encounter structure and target longevity. [[spell:1279350]] is best suited for low target count situations where enemies live long enough to justify manually applying [[spell:589]]. When these conditions are met, it offers a significant damage gain and rewards deliberate, methodical gameplay. While it can function in certain AoE scenarios, its effectiveness drops sharply if targets die too quickly, as the ramp time becomes a liability. [[spell:238558]] is the preferred option for most dungeon and burst oriented environments. By automatically applying [[spell:589]] through [[spell:34914]], it removes a major setup cost and allows Shadow Priest to enter its damage profile much faster. This makes Misery the more practical and consistent choice in Mythic+ and any encounter where rapid target swapping or short-lived enemies are common. 5.2. #### Improved Voidform vs Ancient Madness This choice node directly augments [[spell:228260]] and is almost always taken for both power and pathing reasons, as it leads into key talents like [[spell:407470]] or [[spell:409044]]. While both talents modify the same cooldown, they cater to very different damage profiles and hero talent synergies. [[spell:341240]] will generally not see much play, but can be more burst in niche situations where you want to maximize the damage of a single [[spell:228260]] window and cast more [[spell:1240401]]. [[spell:341240]] is our default starting in Season 2 and represents the [[spell:228260]] extension playstyle, increasing the base value of the cooldown and working well with ![]() Archon. This talent does not change how you play but will make our main cooldown feel more impactful. This can also allow you to run slightly less haste than usual. 5.3. #### Mind's Eye vs Distorted Reality Modifying the way we spend Insanity can have large implications when it comes to playstyle and damage output, which is what makes [[spell:407470]] and [[spell:409044]] often a big choice to make in your build. Builds that prefer [[spell:407470]] will typically already have a good amount of Insanity generation so that you can keep up high uptime of [[spell:335467]] and also play off of interactions that reward more casts of Shadow Word: Madness, such as generating [[spell:341491]] or more [[spell:375767]] uptime. On the other hand, builds that prefer [[spell:409044]] will typically like this choice when you are looking to maximize uptime on [[spell:335467]] (especially at lower gear levels). Distorted Reality builds also can make more use of spreading Shadow Word: Madness in AoE situations to take advantage of effects like [[spell:407469]] if you are okay giving up some priority target damage. 5.4. #### Deathspeaker vs Death and Madness This choice node is currently one of the weakest points in the Shadow Priest tree due to the undertuned state of [[spell:32379]]. As a result, most builds will avoid both options unless forced by pathing or encounter specific add patterns. While [[spell:392507]] and [[spell:321291]] historically synergized well together, being mutually exclusive causes their value propositions to clash, limiting the effectiveness of either choice in practical play. Between the two, [[spell:392507]] is generally the superior option when a point must be spent, largely because it enhances execute phase value and synergizes better with [[spell:34433]] starting at 35% health. This provides more consistent value in longer boss encounters where execute damage matters. [[spell:321291]], by contrast, is highly situational and primarily useful for encounters with frequent, predictable low health add spawns that can be reliably sniped. 6. ### Priest Class Talent Choices While the builds above have sane defaults for Class Talents, this section will go in-depth about the various choices we have with class talents depending on the situation you are in. 6.1. #### Always Use Class Talents The following is a list of class talents I would always use as a Shadow Priest. These are useful in just about every situation in PvE and will be the core talents for any build. - [[spell:8092]] - Baseline - [[spell:8122]] - Baseline - [[spell:121536]] and/or [[spell:64129]] - Movement talents, typically I would suggest having both. - [[spell:528]] and [[spell:73325]] - Useful for pathing and great utility. - [[spell:10060]] and [[spell:373466]] - Damage cooldown and massive group throughput utility. - [[spell:1250818]], [[spell:1251030]], [[spell:1250820]], [[spell:1251077]], [[spell:1251029]], [[spell:1249230]], and [[spell:1250835]] all provide minor offensive or defensive benefits we always take. - [[spell:32379]] is typically taken, in some cases you can skip this but you then need to take [[spell:373218]]. - [[spell:390972]] - Execute damage that unlocks nodes in the bottom section. - [[spell:586]] - One of our most powerful utility and defensive spells. - [[spell:368275]] into [[spell:19236]] for another defensive. - [[spell:459559]] gives us a large increase in the range of our spells. - [[spell:373446]] turns [[spell:586]] into a key defensive. 6.2. #### Situational Class Talents Now that you have an idea of the baseline suggested class talents, you can finish off your build based on the content that you are doing. In some situations, you might need more utility, and for others, if you do not need that utility, you can instead pick up more defensive choices. Enabling War Mode provides the following benefits: - PvP talents enabled in the outdoor world. - 10%+ increase in World Quest rewards at maximum level. - 10%+ more experience gained while leveling. - Earn Conquest Points, which can reward gear every week. With the benefits of enabling War Mode for leveling and PvE content, it is recommended enabling the feature to maximize your leveling and rewards at maximum level.
